name: Operandio
oneLiner: Australian-built operations, checklist, training and compliance platform for franchise and multi-unit hospitality operators, with AI search, course building and translation.
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant groups and franchisors that want digital SOPs, opening and closing checklists, food-safety logs, audits and staff training in one mobile and kiosk-friendly app across every location.

customers.name: Cold Rock Ice Creamery (70+ franchise locations)

updates.text: Acquired FranchiseLab, the franchise recruitment tool co-founded by Greg Nathan, to add franchisee recruitment to its franchise management platform; FranchiseLab keeps its brand.

features: Digital SOPs and a searchable knowledge base, with AI search so staff can ask questions
Task management and digital opening, closing and food-safety checklists
Audits and inspections with automatically generated corrective actions
Training and LMS, including an AI course builder that turns an SOP document into a module and quiz
Food prep label printing and automated temperature sensors for fridges and freezers
Team announcements with read acknowledgment tracking
Location LaunchPad playbooks and pre-opening checklists for new sites
Multilingual translation of SOPs, checklists and training content

pricing.text: Custom pricing based on locations and modules; not published.

notes: No dated 2025 product announcement found; the only confirmed update is the February 2026 FranchiseLab acquisition (also reported by franchise.org.au and franchiseexecutives.com.au). Dropped from current review: '150,000 frontline workers', 'scores 4.9/5 on Capterra' (unverified/changeable), '14-day free trial without a credit card' and 'reviewers describe it as business-friendly' (not confirmed), and 'Franchised Food Company' as a customer (not found). Cold Rock is confirmed. Other case studies listed by casestudies.com/operandio.com: LUCAS Restaurants, Tex's Chicken, Social Fair, BOUNCE Inc., Escalante Golf. Customer stories are vendor-written. AI features come from operandio.com/platform/ai/ with no launch date.
